```yaml
name: Upgrade Check

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  upgrade-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Ruby
      uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
      with:
        ruby-version: '3.0'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        bundle install --path vendor/bundle
        npm install

    - name: Run linting
      run: |
        npm run lint:prettier
        npm run lint:style-contract

    - name: Bootstrap compatibility integration tests
      run: bash test/integration_bootstrap_compat.sh

    - name: Distill integration tests
      run: bash test/integration_distill.sh

    - name: Upgrade CLI integration tests
      run: bash test/integration_upgrade_cli.sh

    - name: Add al_cookie to Gemfile/plugin list
      run: echo "gem 'al_cookie'" >> Gemfile

    - name: Update al_folio.distill.allow_remote_loader
      run: sed -i 's/al_folio\.distill\.allow_remote_loader: false/al_folio\.distill\.allow_remote_loader: true/' config/settings.yml

    - name: Update integration checks
      run: sed -i 's/pinned_distill_runtime_hash/pinned_distill_runtime_hash_from_gem_asset/' test/integration_distill.sh

    - name: Commit changes
      run: |
        git add Gemfile config/settings.yml test/integration_distill.sh
        git commit -m "Upgrade Tailwind v4.1.18, extract core, and improve visual parity"
        git push origin main
```
